title: Whipped Grass-Fed Tallow Cream — Peaceful Night
body_html:
While you sleep, your skin does its most important repair work — and this night tallow cream is designed to support every hour of it. Pasture-raised grass-fed beef tallow melts into skin and gets out of the way, delivering a concentrated lipid repair that lasts through the night. Organic Siberian fir grounds the senses and helps the nervous system release the day. Organic lavender adds its quiet, sleep-supportive signature. Wake up with skin that feels like it finally rested too.

Why whipped grass-fed tallow

Grass-fed tallow contains a fatty-acid composition — stearic, oleic, palmitic, and palmitoleic acids — that closely mirrors the ratios in healthy human sebum. That biological similarity means tallow doesn't just sit on top of skin; it's recognized and absorbed efficiently. Overnight, when skin is in active renewal mode and not fighting environmental stressors, that absorption goes even deeper.

Grass-fed matters for what it adds: higher conjugated linoleic acid (CLA), more fat-soluble vitamins A, D, E, and K, and a better omega-3 to omega-6 ratio compared to grain-fed tallow. Vitamin A (as retinol precursors) naturally supports overnight cell turnover. Vitamin E defends against oxidative stress. Together, these nutrients work in rhythm with your skin's natural nocturnal repair cycle — no synthetic retinoids or fragrance required.

  • Sebum-compatible fats — absorbed efficiently, not just coated on surface
  • Grass-fed nutrient advantage — naturally higher in vitamins A, D, E, K and CLA
  • Overnight repair alignment — lipid-dense formula works with skin's nocturnal renewal phase
  • No synthetic preservatives — tallow's lipid structure is inherently resistant to oxidation when stored properly

The scent

Organic Siberian fir brings a clean forest note — grounding, slightly resinous, earthy without being heavy. It's the kind of scent that signals the nervous system to slow down. Organic lavender adds its familiar herbal calm, reinforcing the shift from the stimulation of the day into the quiet of night. The combined scent is gentle and fades within 30 minutes, so it supports sleep without competing with it.

Key ingredients

  • Grass-fed beef tallow — lipid-rich base that closely mirrors human sebum; carrier of fat-soluble vitamins for overnight repair
  • Organic olive oil — rich in squalene and oleic acid; deeply softening and skin-protective
  • Organic jojoba oil — a liquid wax that mimics sebum structure and helps the formula spread and absorb without residue
  • Organic Siberian fir oil — grounding forest scent; skin-soothing properties; traditionally associated with calm and rest
  • Organic lavender oil — calms skin reactivity, supports relaxation, classic sleep-supportive aromatherapy

What it does

  • Deep overnight moisture repair — concentrated lipid formula restores barrier integrity depleted by daily washing, weather, and exposure
  • Supports skin's nocturnal renewal cycle — fat-soluble vitamins and CLA nourish skin during peak cellular repair hours
  • Calms reactive, stressed skin — lavender and tallow's native fatty acids reduce overnight redness and sensitivity
  • Softens rough texture by morning — deeply moisturized skin wakes up noticeably smoother, especially in dry seasons or postpartum
  • Sleep-supportive aromatherapy — Siberian fir and lavender help signal the mind and body toward rest

How to use

  1. As the final step of your evening skincare routine, scoop a pea-sized amount onto clean fingertips.
  2. Warm the cream between your palms for 2–3 seconds until it softens.
  3. Press and massage gently into face, neck, and any dry patches on the body.
  4. Apply after any serums or treatments — tallow cream is your last layer before sleep.

Who it's for

The Peaceful Night cream is made for anyone who wants their skincare routine to do double duty: repair the skin and help wind down the mind. It's especially suited for moms who struggle to transition from the pace of the day into genuine rest — and for anyone dealing with postpartum dryness, seasonal skin fatigue, or the particular roughness that comes from chronically disrupted sleep. If your skin needs more than your daytime cream can give it, your nights are where this works.

Free from

No seed oils • No parabens • No sulfates • No synthetic fragrance • No PEGs • No phthalates

Our sourcing story

Leaf & Bird sources tallow exclusively from pasture-raised, grass-fed cattle — animals raised on open land, eating what they were meant to eat. We use tallow as part of a nose-to-tail approach: nothing wasted, everything purposeful. This was the moisturizer our grandmothers reached for before the beauty industry decided petroleum was progress. We didn't reinvent it. We just gave it an ingredient label worthy of what it always was.

Size & specs

2 oz (56g) · Made in USA · 100% Organic Oils · Store in a cool location away from direct sunlight.

Full ingredient list

Grass-Fed Beef Tallow, Organic Olive Oil, Organic Jojoba Oil, Organic Siberian Fir Oil, Organic Lavender Oil

Suggested use: Apply a small amount to fingertips and massage into skin as the last step of your evening routine. Fully absorbs after a few minutes. A little goes a long way.

Warning: For external use only. Avoid direct contact with eyes. Discontinue use if irritation occurs. Keep out of reach of children. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.

faq_json.question: What does this cream smell like?
faq_json.answer: Leaf & Bird's Peaceful Night cream has a grounding, forest-meets-floral scent. Organic Siberian fir leads with a clean, slightly resinous evergreen note — earthy and calming, not sharp. Organic lavender adds a familiar herbal softness underneath. Together the scent is quiet and sleep-supportive. It fades gently within 20–30 minutes of application, so it sets the tone for rest without interfering with sleep.

faq_json.question: Can I use this every night?
faq_json.answer: Yes — this is designed for daily nighttime use. Grass-fed tallow, olive oil, and jojoba oil are all gentle enough for nightly application on face and body. The formula contains no actives that cause purging or sensitivity buildup, so there's no reason to cycle off it. Many users find their skin noticeably softer within the first 1–2 weeks of consistent nightly use.

faq_json.question: Should I apply this before or after serums?
faq_json.answer: Apply tallow cream as the last step of your evening routine, after any water-based serums or treatments. Layering order: cleanse → tone (if used) → treatment serum → tallow cream to seal. Because tallow is lipid-rich, it creates a mild occlusive layer that helps lock in the ingredients beneath it. If you use a retinol treatment, apply the retinol first, wait a few minutes, then apply the cream over it.

faq_json.question: Is this safe to use during pregnancy?
faq_json.answer: The formula contains grass-fed beef tallow, organic olive oil, organic jojoba oil, organic Siberian fir oil, and organic lavender oil — no retinoids, no salicylic acid, no parabens, and no synthetic fragrance. Please consult your OB/GYN or midwife before introducing any new skincare product during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Individual sensitivities vary. This is informational only and not medical advice.

faq_json.question: Can I use this on my baby at bedtime?
faq_json.answer: Many parents reach for simple tallow cream as a gentle overnight moisturizer for babies, and Leaf & Bird's clean formulation makes it a reasonable option. We recommend performing a small patch test on your baby's inner arm first and waiting 24 hours before broader use. Siberian fir and lavender are gentle essential oils, but very young skin can respond differently. Consult your pediatrician before use on infants. This is not medical advice.

faq_json.question: How long does one jar last?
faq_json.answer: A 2 oz jar typically lasts 6–10 weeks at daily facial use. Tallow cream is concentrated — a pea-sized amount softens quickly and covers the full face, neck, and a few dry patches. If you're using it for full-body application nightly, expect 3–4 weeks per jar. Either way, it's a dense, high-value jar relative to what most conventional night creams deliver.

faq_json.question: How much should I use each night?
faq_json.answer: Start with a pea-sized amount for facial and neck coverage. Warm it between your palms for 2–3 seconds and it will soften enough to press and spread evenly. Because tallow is highly concentrated, a small amount goes further than you'd expect. Using more won't improve results — it just means the jar runs out faster. For dry body areas like elbows, heels, or shins, a coin-sized amount per zone is usually sufficient.
